_comment: Corrections for UMinho building 11 (IPIN 2022), in the site frame (metres, x along the image, y up).
Stairwells are read off the plans and checked against the landmarks where training walks change floor.

outdoor_ne is not drawn: training walks go from floor 0 at (82, 69) to floor 1 at (105, 67) outside the building in about 20 s, so the ground rises there (the building sits on a slope). Its area is the outdoor strip between those landmarks.
Doorways the plans draw shut (entrances to the patio) are cut where training walks cross them (sites.json walked_doors).
